title: London’s Day of the Dead 2026
summary: A Day of the Dead celebration on Columbia Road from midday on Saturday 31 October 2026. The venue's news post says it is free.

notes_for_verifier: Start time 'From 12pm' is printed; no end time. The news post listing is the source; the event's own post was not read, so the verifier may wish to check it. Columbia Road's own site gives its Sunday hours as 'Sundays from 8am ’til 3'ish'; this event is not on a Sunday.
